title: FPF Vocabulary Log Record
description: Per-term entry for vocabulary stabilization and drift detection. Each JSONL line is one term in one bounded context. External tools group by uts_id to reconstruct term sheets, or by term name + timestamp to detect semantic drift over time.

uts_id.description: Parent UTS identifier. Multiple terms with the same uts_id form one term sheet.

session_id.description: Session in which this term was defined

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 when term entry was recorded

domain.description: Cynefin domain when term was defined

depth_tier.description: FPF depth tier when term was defined

sense_cell.description: Meaning of this term in one bounded context. Multiple sense_cell records (same term_id, different context) represent the full sense-cell map for this term.

differentiators.description: How this meaning differs from same term in other contexts

risk.description: What this alias conflates or hides

bridge_notes.description: How to translate this term when crossing context boundaries

decision_log_ids.description: DRR-IDs where this term was critical

evidence_log_ids.description: Evidence records that tested or validated this term's meaning
